# Inspacco (Prophandy Technologies Private Limited)

Inspacco is a Facilities Services company. INSPACCO is a one-stop solution for facility improvement and maintenance services for residential societies, commercial spaces, and corporates. They offer services such as housekeeping, cleaning, sanitization, security, disinfection, waterproofing, pest control, repair, and maintenance. They empower the vendor ecosystem by solving problems related to new business leads, internal and external communication, and working capital management. Inspacco employs 87 people (+22.9% YoY, +19 people), founded in 2019. Headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, India, with presence in United States.

## About

Inspacco is a new-aged tech-led B2B facility management services' ecosystem platform.

We operate in 25 States and 500+ cities. With 10000+ active suppliers. 

FACILITY MANAGEMENT SERVICES | MANPOWER SERVICES | EV INFRASTRUCTURE & PUBLIC CHARGING | TURNKEY PROJECT | CO - WORKING SPACES | EV FLEET MANAGEMENT |

SaaS Platform for end-to-end - Stakeholder, Task, Complaint, and Attendance management.
